title: List of Anniversary Celebration elite skills
wikitext:
The [[Anniversary Celebration|15th Anniversary Celebration]] in 2020 added 10 new Elite Skills to the game, one for each profession. They can only be captured from bosses that spawn in certain areas when at least one party member has a [[Proof of Triumph]].

It is notable that these Anniversary Elite Skills are considered [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]], which prevents player characters from learning them by using [[Skill tome|Elite Skill Tomes]].
